findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "platform-mcp.crm-connector.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_connection_guide, get_ai_agents_info, search_records, list_related_records, read_activities, send_request, get_profile · Private data: plan_integration, find_sync_options, get_field_details, get_connection_guide, list_integrations, run_sync, get_sync_health, resolve_conflict, get_ai_agents_info, list_ai_systems, describe_record_type, search_records, get_record, find_linked_records, list_related_records, propose_changes, apply_proposal, undo_change, propose_automation · Public sink: find_sync_options, set_integration_status, list_ai_systems, search_records, propose_changes, propose_automation, send_request, get_profile · Destructive: run_sync, list_automations, set_automation_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_connection_guide, get_ai_agents_info, search_records, list_related_records, read_activities, send_request, get_profile · Private data: plan_integration, find_sync_options, get_field_details, get_connection_guide, list_integrations, run_sync, get_sync_health, resolve_conflict, get_ai_agents_info, list_ai_systems, describe_record_type, search_records, get_record, find_linked_records, list_related_records, propose_changes, apply_proposal, undo_change, propose_automation · Public sink: find_sync_options, set_integration_status, list_ai_systems, search_records, propose_changes, propose_automation, send_request, get_profile · Destructive: run_sync, list_automations, set_automation_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
